title: AI for Computational Design Science: A Responsible Human-AI Framework and Case Study on Short-Form Video Safety Surveillance
abstract: arXiv:2609.05270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming not only what information systems researchers design, but also how design research is conducted. Yet existing literature offers limited guidance for computational design science (CDS) when AI actively participates in problem formulation, resource construction, design search, evaluation, and knowledge abstraction. We develop AI for Computational Design Science (AI4CDS), a five-phase methodological framework in which AI expands problem and design search while researchers retain responsibility for domain grounding, admissibility, verification, and scientific judgment. Collaboration is governed by graduated trust, reversibility, auditability, and differentiated reproducibility. We instantiate AI4CDS through ChildRiskGuard, an interpretable artifact for detecting short-form videos inappropriate for children, while documenting AI interactions, rejected alternatives, corrections, and audit trails. translated_title: 面向计算设计科学的人工智能：负责任的人机协作框架及短视频安全监测案例研究
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）不仅正在改变信息系统研究者所设计的内容，也在改变设计研究的开展方式。然而，当AI积极参与问题表述、资源构建、设计搜索、评估和知识抽象时，现有文献对计算设计科学（CDS）提供的指导十分有限。我们开发了面向计算设计科学的人工智能（AI4CDS），这是一个五阶段方法论框架，其中AI扩展了问题和设计搜索的空间，而研究者则保留对领域基础、可采性、验证和科学判断的责任。人机协作由分级信任、可逆性、可审计性和差异化可复现性来规范。我们通过ChildRiskGuard实例化了AI4CDS框架，这是一个用于检测不适合儿童的短视频的可解释制品，同时记录了AI交互过程、被拒绝的替代方案、修正内容和审计轨迹。
tldr: 该论文提出AI4CDS五阶段方法论框架，界定了AI在设计研究中扩展搜索的角色与研究者的科学责任边界，并通过儿童短视频安全检测系统ChildRiskGuard完成了框架的实例化验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AI4CDS, a five-phase methodological framework where AI expands problem and design search while researchers retain scientific judgment, instantiated through ChildRiskGuard, an interpretable artifact for detecting child-inappropriate short-form videos.
